approach: PlayStation 2 Emotion Engine program, VU0 and VU1 microprograms statically translated to C; the graphics drawn natively by GX and the sound mixed on the Wii
notes: Runs natively on a real Wii, launched with the Homebrew Channel. Sideways Wii Remote with tilt and shake controls, or a Classic Controller as the DualShock; rumble; widescreen; 480p.
